kindred-hospital-la-mirada.quote: use wage garnishment or a sale of a patient’s primary residence as a means of collecting bad debt, except as expressly permitted
kindred-hospital-la-mirada.explanation: The ban covers only sale of a primary residence and has an exception. Ask whether a debt buyer can place a lien on or sell any real property you own.

watsonville-community-hospital.quote: use wage garnishments or liens on primary residences

west-anaheim-medical-center.quote: Legal efforts (e.g., wage garnishment, liens, and judgements) are allowable if:

woodland-memorial-hospital.quote: In determining eligibility, CommonSpirit Hospital Organization may consider the ‘monetary assets’ of the patient’s Family.
woodland-memorial-hospital.explanation: The policy permits considering family monetary assets. It may be a multistate policy with California carve-outs elsewhere, but as written it applies the forbidden test.

woodland-memorial-hospital.quote: The Hospital Facility will not engage in ECAs against an individual prior to making a reasonable effort to determine eligibility under this Policy.
woodland-memorial-hospital.explanation: The policy lists credit bureau reporting as a possible collection action it may take after certain steps. Ask the hospital whether it reports California patients to credit bureaus, which state law now forbids.
